connections.why: Fuels and appliances are sources of the energy that is transferred
Each transfer is a change whose total energy stays the same
Heating transfers energy that raises a material's internal energy
Forces are what change an object's speed or direction of motion
Balanced and unbalanced forces decide whether motion changes
Pressure is force spread over an area acting in a fluid
Work done by a force stretches springs and changes energy stores
Weight is the gravitational force acting on a mass
Sound shares wave behaviour such as reflection with water waves
Light is compared with waves in matter to understand its behaviour
Sound and ultrasound waves transfer energy and information
Light transfers energy from a source to an absorber
Current is the flow of the charges static electricity separates
Static charge produces a non-contact force, like gravity and magnetism
A current creates a magnetic effect used in electromagnets and motors
The particle model explains melting, diffusion and density changes
Heating changes the motion and spacing of particles
Gravity holds the Sun, planets and galaxies together
The Earth orbits the Sun under gravity, and its tilt gives seasons
